category_title: Students experiencing sensory overload and avoidance behaviors due to trauma
scenario_title: Arriving to class unprepared after navigating triggering hallways
minimal_context: Natasha arrives at the classroom and is asked to take out her textbook and assignment for the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take your seat. We are starting the lesson, so take out your textbook and the assignment from yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't have my book. The hallways... the smells out there made me dizzy and weak... sick to my stomach almost.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need the book for today's lesson. What about the assignment?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I only have part of it done. Everything is just cloudy upstairs today. It takes all my effort just remembering what room it is in and going.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Oh, Natasha, you chose to join us today. We expect you to be prepared when you do.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs her bag and turns to leave the classroom) I can't do this. When you say things like that, you just don't want to go back after that.
